import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Parse blood pressure into systolic and diastolic
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [16, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 10

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True)

# Create grid for subplots
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 4, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep metrics by occupation
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0:2])
sleep_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
sleep_metrics.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e'])
ax1.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Score')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.legend(title='Metrics')

# 2. Physical activity vs sleep quality scatter
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2:])
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], s=df['Daily Steps']/100, 
                      cmap='Reds', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Sleep Quality', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level')

# Add size legend for daily steps
sizes = [3000, 6000, 10000]
labels = ['3k', '6k', '10k']
handles = [plt.scatter([], [], s=s/100, edgecolors='black', facecolors='gray', alpha=0.7) 
           for s in sizes]
ax2.legend(handles, labels, title='Daily Steps', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1))

# 3. BMI category distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = ['#2ca02c' if cat == 'Normal' else '#d62728' if cat == 'Obese' else '#ff7f0e' 
          for cat in bmi_counts.index]
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Blood pressure by BMI category
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bp_data = df.groupby('BMI Category')[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']].mean()
bp_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#e377c2', '#17becf'])
ax4.set_title('Blood Pressure by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.legend(title='BP Type')

# 5. Heart rate distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax5.hist(df['Heart Rate'], bins=5, color='#9467bd', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax5.axvline(df['Heart Rate'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, 
            label=f'Mean: {df["Heart Rate"].mean():.1f}')
ax5.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend()

# 6. Correlation heatmap
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 3])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=0.5, ax=ax6, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax6.set_title('Feature Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Sleep disorder analysis
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
sleep_disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] != '']
if len(sleep_disorder_data) > 0:
    disorder_metrics = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                       'Stress Level', 'Daily Steps']
    
    # Normalize data for radar chart
    normal_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == ''][disorder_metrics].mean()
    disorder_data = sleep_disorder_data[disorder_metrics].mean()
    
    # Create radar chart
    angles = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, len(disorder_metrics), endpoint=False).tolist()
    angles += angles[:1]
    
    normal_values = normal_data.tolist()
    normal_values += normal_values[:1]
    
    disorder_values = disorder_data.tolist()
    disorder_values += disorder_values[:1]
    
    ax7 = plt.subplot(gs[2, :], polar=True)
    ax7.plot(angles, normal_values, 'o-', linewidth=2, label='No Disorder', color='green')
    ax7.fill(angles, normal_values, alpha=0.25, color='green')
    ax7.plot(angles, disorder_values, 'o-', linewidth=2, label='Sleep Apnea', color='red')
    ax7.fill(angles, disorder_values, alpha=0.25, color='red')
    
    ax7.set_xticks(angles[:-1])
    ax7.set_xticklabels(disorder_metrics)
    ax7.set_title('Sleep Disorder vs Normal: Key Metrics Comparison', 
                  fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
    ax7.legend(loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(1.3, 1.1))
else:
    ax7.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No sleep disorder data available', 
             ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
    ax7.axis('off')

# Add overall title
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
